This is a live walkthrough of the showroom's AI analytics overlay. Here's what you'll see:
  • A full 3D model of both showroom floors, with 23 analytics cameras placed exactly where they sit in-store.

  • Section labels act as buttons — press one to fly to that section and open its live analytics dashboard.
  • Cafeteria and Waiting Area monitoring, including automatic alerts when a visitor waits too long unattended.
  • A full Surveillance Room with every camera, alert history, and a per-visitor activity log.

📱 WhatsApp Alerts
Sends a WhatsApp message the moment a security alert fires (theft/unattended product, coverage gaps, etc.) — routed through a small relay you host, since a browser page can never hold the API key needed to send WhatsApp messages directly.
How to set up the relay (one-time, ~10 min)
  1. Get WhatsApp Cloud API access from Meta for Developers — you'll get a phone number ID and a permanent access token.
  2. Deploy the small relay script (download link appears next to this app's file) to a free host like Cloudflare Workers — it's the piece that actually calls Meta's API, since your token can't live in this page's JavaScript.
  3. Paste the relay's URL above as the webhook, add the WhatsApp number to notify, and save.
  4. Note: WhatsApp requires a pre-approved message template for any alert sent outside a 24-hour customer conversation window — Meta's business verification covers this, no India DLT registration needed (that's SMS-only).

📦 Predictive Sell-Through
—
Building today's forecast…
Stock, sales history and open purchase orders come from the Stock Ledger and start as SIMULATED data (no POS/inventory feed connected yet), generated from per-collection demand, weekday/festival/wedding-season effects and supplier lead times. The reorder-point, days-of-cover and trend logic, thresholds and notification routing are real and ready to point at live data.

Stock ledger

—

Opening stock, POS sales and supplier POs are simulated (no live feed yet). Entries you record are saved in this browser, feed the forecast immediately and alert Supply, Marketing or Sales when a threshold is crossed.
📱 Team Alerts
Sends a WhatsApp message the moment a size/collection prediction crosses a threshold — reorder predictions go to Supply, rising-trend predictions go to Marketing, slow-moving stock goes to Sales. Uses the same relay you set up for security alerts.
